questions.prompt: Postfix on mx.example.com accepts mail from Gmail's servers. Port? (number)
Thunderbird reads mail over TLS, keeping it on the server. Port? (number)
An old client downloads mail with POP3 over TLS. Port? (number)
Outlook on a laptop sends a new message to its own server with STARTTLS. Port? (number)
A firewall rule allows inbound TCP 143 and 110 from the Internet. What's the problem?
options: They're the plain-text IMAP and POP ports, so passwords can cross the Internet unencrypted

questions.prompt: Which protocol is used to READ mail?
Your mail server must receive mail from the Internet, and staff must send and read from home. Which inbound ports do you open?
DHCP and ordinary DNS lookups use UDP; SMTP, IMAP, and POP use TCP.
Which port does an MSA using implicit TLS (TLS from the first byte) listen on? (number)
